q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT F.FOLLOWER, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE = F.FOLLOWER) > 0 THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE = F.FOLLOWER) ELSE 0 END AS NUM FROM FOLLOW F GROUP BY F.FOLLOWER HAVING NUM > 0 ORDER BY F.FOLLOWER
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 counts the number of followers for each user who is also being followed by another user. Q2, on the other hand, counts the number of followers for each user and only includes those users in the result if they are being followed by another user.
counterexample_dsp: A user who is being followed by another user but has no followers of their own.
